description: Life moments people ask Satro about. Themes come from public reporting on Gen Z dating anxiety, career worry and astrology-app questions. Match order matters: specific moments first.
disclaimer: Traditional/symbolic guidance for fun and reflection. You make the call.

moments.label: Make up after a fight
moments.question: Good time to fix things after a fight?
moments.match: \b(fight|fought|argu\w*|patch up|make up|apolog\w*|say sorry|mad at me|angry at me)\b
tips: Start with how you feel, not who was right.
Ask what they needed in that moment, then really listen.
Pick a calm moment and put the phones down.
moments.note: If a fight ever leaves you feeling unsafe, please reach out to someone you trust.

moments.label: Text them first
moments.question: Should I text them first?
tips: Keep it light: one easy line beats a long paragraph.
Say what you actually mean. No decoding games.
Send it, then go enjoy your day.

moments.label: Tell your crush
moments.question: When should I tell my crush?
moments.match: \b(confess\w*|crush|shoot my shot|ask (him|her|them) out|tell (him|her|them) i like|my feelings)\b
tips: Keep it simple: "I like spending time with you."
Give them room to answer in their own time.
Being brave already counts as a win.

moments.label: First date
moments.question: Best time for a first date?
moments.match: \b(first date|on a date|plan a date|a date(?! night))\b
tips: Pick a spot where you can actually talk.
Have one fun question ready to break the ice.
Be curious, not perfect.

moments.label: Romantic night
moments.question: When's the most romantic time?
tips: Small and thoughtful beats big and expensive.
Phones away for the first hour.
Plan one little surprise.

moments.label: Meet someone new
moments.question: When can I find love?
moments.lead: I can't promise when love shows up, but I can show you the best time to put yourself out there.
tips: Say yes to one plan you'd normally skip.
Refresh one photo and one line on your profile.
Go where your people already are.

moments.label: Have "the talk"
moments.question: When do I ask what we are?
moments.match: \b(situationship|what are we|what we are|define the relationship|dtr|the talk|exclusive|talking stage)\b
tips: Say what you want, not what you think they want.
"I'm looking for..." is a great way to start.
Their answer is clarity, whichever way it goes.

moments.label: Heal and move on
moments.question: I'm going through a breakup. What helps today?
moments.lead: That really hurts, and it makes sense that you're feeling it. Be extra kind to yourself.
tips: Mute before you block. Give yourself some space.
Call the friend who always gets it.
Move your body a little, even just a walk.

moments.label: Talk to family
moments.question: Good time for a big family talk?
tips: Start with what you appreciate about them.
Pick a relaxed moment, ideally after a meal.
Listen first, then share your side.

moments.label: Girls' night out
moments.question: Best time for a night out with friends?
tips: Pick the plan and the time now, or the group chat never will.
Take the photos early, while everyone still looks amazing.
Sort your ride home before you head out.

moments.label: Job interview
moments.question: Best time to prep for my interview?
tips: Practice your "tell me about yourself" out loud twice.
Prepare two stories that show what you can do.
Bring two questions of your own.

moments.label: Big meeting or pitch
moments.question: When should I schedule my big meeting?
tips: Open with the one thing you want them to remember.
Keep it short and leave time for questions.
Share the next step before everyone leaves.

moments.label: Ask for a raise
moments.question: When should I ask for a raise?
tips: Bring three wins with real results.
Know your number before you walk in.
Ask for a quick chat rather than ambushing them.

moments.label: Job hunt
moments.question: When will I get a job?
moments.lead: I can't promise a date, but I can point you to your best time to go for it.
tips: Send three tailored applications instead of thirty copies.
Message one person in a company you like.
Celebrate the effort. Results follow in their own time.

moments.label: Start something new
moments.question: Good time to start something new?
tips: Start small enough that you can begin today.
Share it with one person you trust first.
Done and live beats perfect and hidden.

moments.label: Exam prep
moments.question: Best time to study for my exam?
tips: Try 25 minutes of focus, then a 5 minute break.
Test yourself instead of rereading notes.
Sleep counts as studying. Really.

moments.label: Deep study session
moments.question: When's my best focus time?
tips: Put your phone in another room.
Pick one task and do only that.
Start with just five minutes.

moments.label: Big money move
moments.question: Good time for a big purchase?
tips: Sleep on anything big for one night.
Compare at least two options.
Set your budget before you browse.
moments.note: For real money decisions, check with a qualified professional.

moments.label: Workout
moments.question: Best time to work out today?
tips: Ten minutes still counts.
Play the song that makes you feel unstoppable.
Drink some water first.

moments.label: Trip or travel
moments.question: Good time for a trip?
tips: Leave a little earlier than you think you need to.
Pack the night before.
Save your tickets offline.

moments.label: Reset and recharge
moments.question: I'm feeling drained. When can I recharge?
moments.lead: Thanks for telling me. Slowing down is a good move, not a step back.
tips: Take ten slow breaths, right now.
Step outside for a few minutes.
Tell one person how you're really doing.
